page.layout: Running head at top centre-right ("Ehrenpfort"), page number at top left. Below: three columns of Latin place names in roman type (col. 1: Goennis / Gibraltaris, & Insularum Canariae; col. 2: Algalbi / Insularum Indiarum & maris Oceani; col. 3: Algisire / XV. Infulæ). Beneath them, three columns of black-letter names (col. 1: Burgund to Molia; col. 2: Loterich to Mechelen; col. 3: Brabant to Salms). Then full-width German black-letter text: a caption line, two paragraphs, an inscription line and a closing inscription block. Catchword at bottom right.

l.bl: Folget die Pforte deß Lobs zur rechten
hand / so etwas niderer als die größere mitler.
Selbige hat zu oberst / wie auch die deß
Adels auff der lincken seit / daß gülden Fluß.
Auff dieser Pforten Seulen einer zur lin-
cken / so an die Ehrenpfort deß grossen mitlern
Thurn stößet / stehet zu oberst / unter andern
Zierden / Keyser Friedrichs Bildnuß / in ziem-
Auff der andern grossen Seul gegen über

page.notes: Black-letter names in the three columns are tagged as black letter; Latin names are roman. Uncertain readings: "XV'. Infulæ" (top line of col. 3 may read Jnfulæ or Insulæ), "Loterich" (may be Loteriich), "Rofsilion" (may be Roísilion), "Hierzwi" (catchword cut off at the page edge). The page number "198" is printed in the old-style figures at top left. The large caption "Folget die Pforte..." is set in larger type and treated as a level-2 head. The inscription lines are centred and larger in print but are quotations, so they are marked as paragraphs.
